entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The imported goods have been detained.
Based on the direction of this Court, the sample of imported goods has been send for lab analysis.
The report has been received in a sealed cover.
On going through the lab report, it is seen that the petitioners goods are in conformity to the standards and there is no impurity or contamination.

2. However, the learned Standing counsel for the respondent points out that, in view of the defects in terms of Section 23 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2011 (hereinafter referred to as 'Act' for short), the petitioner's imported goods cannot be released.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the above defects are curable defects.

Considering the facts and circumstances, the following directions are issued:
Based on the Lab report, the petitioner's goods shall be permitted to release on condition that the petitioner cures the defect as pointed out by the learned counsel for the petitioner in terms of Section 23 of the 'Act' referred as above, if otherwise such defects are curable.
The writ petition is disposed of as above.

Sd/ A.MUHAMED MUSTAQUE, JUDGE jm/
